facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reported that Tanzania's TTCL signed a five-year partnership with Burundi Backbone System, worth about US$3.3 million, to resell high-speed capacity from Tanzania's national ICT backbone to Burundi.

note: The article says capacity will be resold over the next five years and does not state the link lit or Burundi's body using it, so no service fact is recorded.
